name: Shea 佘 Family in China
bio:
The Shea family originated from ZhongShan (中山) (formerly HeongShan 香山) in Guangdong, China. 

The family has a long history in the region, with records dating back several generations. 

 The ancestors were primarily involved in trade before some members migrated to Malaya in the early 20th century.

name: Shea Woon Mun

birth.place:
ZhongShan (中山) (formerly HeongShan 香山),
 Guangdong, China

bio:
Woon Mun migrated to Malaya in the early 1910s, and returned to China a few times. 
 When the China closed its borders, he could not return to Malaya. Woon Mun then moved to Tianjin, China for work. 
 He returned to Malaya in 1958. 
Woon Mun was the younger twin brother of Keng Yat.

name: Tham Yoke Keng
bio:
Yoke Keng was born in Hawaii, USA. 
 She married Woon Mun in ZhongShan China and migrated to Malaya with him. 
 Yoke Keng was known for her strong support of the family.

name: Shea Keng Yat

birth.place:
ZhongShan (中山) (formerly HeongShan 香山), 
 Guangdong, China

bio: Keng Yat was the elder twin brother of Woon Mun. He migrated to Malaya and subsequently settled with Woon Mun's family in Kepong, Kuala Lumpur.

name: Shea Poh Sum

birth.place:
ZhongShan (中山) (formerly HeongShan 香山),
 Guangdong, China

bio:
Poh Sum was the son of Woon Mun and Yoke Keng. He migrated to Malaya with his parents and later part of life settled in Petaling Jaya, Selangor. 
 He was an avid photographer and managed a photography business in downtown Kuala Lumpur. Poh Sum was known for his dedication to family.

name: Lee Mun Kay
bio: Mun Kay was born in Malaya. She married Poh Sum and lived in Petaling Jaya, Selangor.

name: Shea Yuet Ming
bio: Yuet Ming was the eldest daughter of Poh Sum and Mun Kay.

name: Shea Weng Keong
bio: Weng Keong was the eldest son of Poh Sum and Mun Kay. He unfortunately passed away at a young age.

name: Shea Weng Cheong
bio: Weng Cheong is the second son of Poh Sum and Mun Kay. He was in the medical field in Kuala Lumpur. He now lives in Shah Alam, Selangor, Malaysia.

name: Lee Bee Loo
bio: Bee Loo was born in Malaysia. She married Weng Cheong and lives in Shah Alam, Selangor, Malaysia.

name: Shea Wai Leong
bio:
Wai Leong is the eldest son of Weng Cheong. He was born in Petaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia, and later moved to Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada for studies. 

He returned to Malaysia in 1996 and currently lives in Shah Alam, Selangor. 

 He also maintains the genealogy records for the family.

name: Elaine Chen
bio: Elaine Chen was born in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. She married Wai Leong and currently lives in Shah Alam, Selangor, Malaysia.

name: Shea Wan Hoe
bio: Wan Hoe is the only child of Wai Leong. He was born in Shah Alam, Selangor, Malaysia, and currently studying in Melaka, Malaysia.

name: Shea Wai Ling
bio: Wai Ling is the second child and only daughter of Weng Cheong. She was born in Petaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia, and later moved to Shah Alam, Selangor, Malaysia. She currently lives in Singapore.

name: Shea Yuet Seong
